$self.label: Person
$self.description: A person active in digital humanities: researcher, developer, librarian, student and so on.

affiliations.label: Affiliations
affiliations.description: The organizations the person is employed by or a formal member of, with role and dates. Not for project involvement.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short introduction to the person — their work and interests — aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

emails.label: Email addresses
emails.description: Contact email addresses. Only list addresses the person has agreed to publish.

family_name.label: Family name
family_name.description: The person’s last name, in one or more languages. Use together with the given name; not for a full name.

given_name.label: Given name
given_name.description: The person’s first name, in one or more languages. Use together with the family name; not for a full name.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The person’s own website or public profile page, if one exists.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the person record is created. The person’s ORCID goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: A portrait or avatar of the person. Leave empty if none is available.

orcid.label: ORCID
orcid.description: The person’s ORCID identifier. Strongly recommended for researchers — it helps link and deduplicate records.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this person in other systems, such as Wikidata or VIAF. The person’s own website belongs in the homepage field.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the person’s expertise and interests, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a person.

$self.label: Organization
$self.description: An organization of any kind — university, GLAM institution, research center, funder, company or non-profit.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the organization beyond its website, such as a blog, social-media profile or registry entry.

address.label: Address
address.description: The organization’s postal address, in one or more languages.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the organization, such as an office or department mailbox.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of the organization and its activities, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the organization record is created. The organization’s ROR identifier goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: The organization’s logo or a representative image. Leave empty if none is available.

location.label: Location
location.description: The place where the organization is based, such as a city.

marketplace_sync.label: Allow Marketplace synchronization
marketplace_sync.description: Allow this organization and its related services and tools to be synchronized with the DARIAH SSH Open Marketplace.

name.label: Name
name.description: The organization’s name, in one or more languages. Prefer the official localized name.

organization_hierarchy.label: Organization hierarchy
organization_hierarchy.description: The parent organizations this organization is formally part of, with optional dates. Only for formal containment, such as a department within a university — not for partnerships or informal association.

organization_type.label: Organization type
organization_type.description: The kind of organization. Always set it.

ror.label: ROR identifier
ror.description: The organization’s ROR registry identifier. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this organization in other systems, such as Wikidata. The organization’s own website belongs in the homepage field.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the organization’s activities and focus, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as an organization.

$self.label: Facility
$self.description: A physical or virtual facility such as a DH lab, digitization studio or research infrastructure. Use a facility when it has its own identity distinct from its host organization.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the facility, such as a blog, social-media profile or press coverage.

address.label: Address
address.description: The facility’s postal address, in one or more languages.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the facility, such as a lab or service-desk mailbox.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of the facility and what it offers researchers, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

facility_affiliations.label: Facility affiliations
facility_affiliations.description: The organizations that host or own this facility, with role and optional dates.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The facility’s own web page, if one exists.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the facility record is created.

image.label: Image
image.description: A photo or logo of the facility. Leave empty if none is available.

location.label: Location
location.description: The place where the facility is situated, such as a city.

name.label: Name
name.description: The facility’s name, in one or more languages.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this facility in other systems. The facility’s own web page belongs in the homepage field.

services_offered.label: Services offered (IDs)
services_offered.description: Services this facility offers to researchers.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the facility’s equipment, expertise and focus, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

tools_provided.label: Tools provided (IDs)
tools_provided.description: Tools this facility maintains or gives access to, such as hosted instances and lab-maintained software — not every tool staff members happen to use.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a facility.

$self.label: Project
$self.description: A digital humanities research project — the central entity of the index, connecting people, organizations, outputs and the periods and places studied.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the project, such as a blog, social-media profile or press coverage.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the project team.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short overview of the project — its goals, methods and outcomes — aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

digital_humanities_activities.label: DH activities
digital_humanities_activities.description: The digital-humanities research activities practiced in the project. Pick the most specific options that apply; multiple values are expected.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.description: When the project ended. Leave empty for ongoing projects.

funding.label: Funding
funding.description: Funding awards received by the project, one entry per distinct award.

funding_status.label: Funding status
funding_status.description: The project’s current funding or sustainability status. Update it when circumstances change; past awards are kept in the funding entries.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The project’s website, if one exists.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the project record is created.

image.label: Image
image.description: A logo or representative image for the project. Leave empty if none is available.

name.label: Name
name.description: The project’s name, in one or more languages. Prefer names supplied by the project team over ad-hoc translations.

organization_roles.label: Organization roles
organization_roles.description: Organizations engaged in the project — as coordinator, partner, data provider, funder or host.

outputs_datasets.label: Output datasets (IDs)
outputs_datasets.description: Datasets produced or curated by the project.

outputs_training_materials.label: Output training materials
outputs_training_materials.description: Training materials produced by the project — not materials it merely used.

project_participations.label: Project participations
project_participations.description: The people involved in the project, with their role and dates.

research_disciplines.label: Research disciplines
research_disciplines.description: The humanities disciplines of the project, such as history, linguistics or archaeology.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this project in other systems, such as a funder’s project registry. The project’s own website belongs in the homepage field.

studied_periods.label: Studied periods
studied_periods.description: The historical periods the project studies, such as the Ottoman period — distinct from the project’s own start and end dates.

studied_places.label: Studied places
studied_places.description: The geographic focus of the research — the places studied, not where the team is based.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the project’s topics and methods, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a project.

uses_datasets.label: Datasets used
uses_datasets.description: Existing datasets used as research inputs. Datasets the project produced belong in output datasets.

uses_services.label: Services used
uses_services.description: Services that support the project’s work.

uses_tools.label: Tools used
uses_tools.description: Tools used to conduct the project. Tools the project produced belong in output tools.

$self.label: Tool
$self.description: A reusable software tool that others can install, run or call. For an offering delivered by people, use a service instead.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the tool, such as a blog post, tutorial or registry entry.

code_repository.label: Code repository
code_repository.description: The source-code repository URL, such as GitHub or GitLab, if open.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the tool’s maintainers.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of what the tool does and who it is for, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

digital_humanities_activities.label: DH activities
digital_humanities_activities.description: The digital-humanities research activities the tool supports. Pick the most specific options that apply; multiple values are expected.

documentation_url.label: Documentation URL
documentation_url.description: User or developer documentation for the tool, such as a manual, wiki or API reference.

doi.label: DOI
doi.description: The tool’s DOI, if one has been assigned — for example through a software deposit.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The tool’s main public page — its website or landing page.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the tool record is created. The tool’s DOI goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: A logo or screenshot of the tool. Leave empty if none is available.

license.label: License
license.description: The license under which the tool is released. Leave empty only if genuinely unknown.

name.label: Name
name.description: The tool’s name, in one or more languages. Use localized names supplied by its team rather than translating a branded name.

programming_language.label: Programming language
programming_language.description: The main implementation language, such as Python. Not for natural languages the tool supports.

resource_contributions.label: Resource contributions
resource_contributions.description: The people and organizations that created, developed or maintain this tool, with role and optional dates.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this tool in other systems, such as Wikidata or the SSH Open Marketplace. The tool’s own pages belong in the homepage or documentation fields.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing what the tool does, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

tool_type.label: Tool type
tool_type.description: How users primarily consume the tool: web app, library, command line and so on.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a tool.

$self.label: Service
$self.description: A service delivered by people at a facility or organization, such as digitization on demand or data curation support. For self-service software, use a tool instead.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the service, such as pricing, terms of use or a blog post.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for requesting or asking about the service.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of what the service provides and who can use it, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

digital_humanities_activities.label: DH activities
digital_humanities_activities.description: The digital-humanities research activities the service supports. Pick the most specific options that apply; multiple values are expected.

documentation_url.label: Documentation URL
documentation_url.description: User documentation for the service, such as a manual or how-to guide.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The service’s public page, if one exists.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the service record is created.

image.label: Image
image.description: A logo or representative image for the service. Leave empty if none is available.

name.label: Name
name.description: The service’s name, in one or more languages. Use localized names supplied by its provider rather than translating a branded name.

provider.label: Provider (ID)
provider.description: The organization responsible for delivering the service — the one you would contact or contract with.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this service in other systems, such as the SSH Open Marketplace. The service’s own page belongs in the homepage field.

service_type.label: Service type
service_type.description: The kind of service offered, such as digitization or consulting.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing what the service provides, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a service.

$self.label: Publication
$self.description: An academic publication: journal article, book, chapter, conference paper, thesis or report.

authorships.label: Authorships
authorships.description: The people who contributed to the publication, with their byline order and role.

date_issued.label: Date issued
date_issued.description: The publication date. If only the year is known, use January 1 of that year.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short summary or abstract of the publication, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

doi.label: DOI
doi.description: The publication’s DOI. Record it whenever one exists.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The publication’s landing page, such as its page on the publisher’s site.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the publication record is created. The publication’s DOI goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: A cover or representative image for the publication. Leave empty if none is available.

name.label: Name
name.description: The title of the publication, in one or more languages.

part_of.label: Part of (ID)
part_of.description: The containing work, such as the book for a chapter or the proceedings for a paper.

presented_at.label: Presented at (event IDs)
presented_at.description: Events where this publication was presented, such as the conference where the paper was given.

publication_type.label: Publication type
publication_type.description: The kind of publication. Pick the most specific value that applies.

published_in.label: Published in
published_in.description: The name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in.

publisher.label: Publisher (ID)
publisher.description: The organization that formally published it.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this publication in other systems, such as a library catalog or Wikidata. Its landing page belongs in the homepage field.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the publication’s topics, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a publication.

$self.label: Event
$self.description: A scholarly event: conference, workshop, seminar, lecture, hackathon or exhibition. For a recurring series, create one record per occurrence.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the event, such as a programme, registration page or recordings.

address.label: Address
address.description: The postal address of the venue, in one or more languages.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the event’s organizers.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of the event — its theme and programme — aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

event_agent_roles.label: Event agents
event_agent_roles.description: The people and organizations involved in the event — organizers, hosts, speakers, participants or sponsors.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The event’s website or announcement page, if one exists.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the event record is created.

image.label: Image
image.description: A poster, banner or photo for the event. Leave empty if none is available.

location.label: Location
location.description: The place where the event takes place, such as a city.

name.label: Name
name.description: The name of the event, in one or more languages.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this event in other systems, such as a conference index. The event’s own page belongs in the homepage field.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the event’s topics, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as an event.

$self.label: Dataset
$self.description: A dataset or similar resource: digital edition, corpus, database, gazetteer, image collection, annotation set or metadata catalog.

byte_size.label: Byte size
byte_size.description: Total size of the dataset in bytes. Leave empty if only a rough estimate is available.

dataset_type.label: Dataset type
dataset_type.description: The dataset’s primary form, such as digital edition, corpus or gazetteer. Its technical format belongs in media type.

datasets.label: Aggregated datasets (IDs)
datasets.description: Datasets aggregated by this record when it functions as a catalog.

date_issued.label: Date issued
date_issued.description: The date the dataset was published. If only the year is known, use January 1 of that year.

derived_from.label: Derived from datasets
derived_from.description: The source datasets this dataset was cleaned, transformed, subsetted or otherwise derived from.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of the dataset’s contents, scope and origin, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

distribution_url.label: Distribution URL
distribution_url.description: A direct download or access URL for the dataset.

doi.label: DOI
doi.description: The dataset’s DOI. Record it whenever one exists.

extent.label: Extent statements
extent.description: Size statements such as record, item, image or file counts — one concise statement per measure, including its unit.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: The dataset’s landing page, such as its page in a repository. A direct download link belongs in the distribution URL field.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the dataset record is created. The dataset’s DOI goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: A representative image for the dataset, such as a sample item or logo. Leave empty if none is available.

in_languages.label: Content languages
in_languages.description: The languages substantially represented in the data itself, not in its documentation.

license.label: License
license.description: The license under which the dataset is released. Leave empty only if genuinely unknown.

media_type.label: Media type
media_type.description: The technical format of the dataset, preferably a standard media type such as text/html or application/pdf. Multiple formats may be listed.

name.label: Name
name.description: The title of the dataset, in one or more languages.

publisher.label: Publisher (ID)
publisher.description: The organization that formally published the dataset.

related_publications.label: Related publications
related_publications.description: Publications that are direct companions of the dataset, such as the print counterpart of a digital edition.

resource_contributions.label: Resource contributions
resource_contributions.description: The people and organizations that created, curated or maintain this dataset, with role and optional dates.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this dataset in other systems, such as a data repository or catalog. Its landing page belongs in the homepage field.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the dataset’s contents, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

themes.label: Themes
themes.description: Thematic keywords for the dataset, in one or more languages.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as a dataset.

$self.label: Training material
$self.description: A tutorial, lesson or other teaching resource that explains how to do something or states what learners will gain from it.

additional_urls.label: Additional URLs
additional_urls.description: Other relevant web pages about the material, such as a blog post or course listing.

contact_email.label: Contact email
contact_email.description: A published contact address for the material’s maintainers.

creators.label: Creators (IDs)
creators.description: The people or organizations that created the material. Use the publisher field for the organization that formally releases it, if different.

date_issued.label: Date issued
date_issued.description: The date the material was published. If only the year is known, use January 1 of that year.

description.label: Description
description.description: A short description of what the material teaches and how, aimed at index visitors, in one or more languages.

digital_humanities_activities.label: DH activities
digital_humanities_activities.description: The digital-humanities research activities the material teaches. Pick the most specific options that apply; multiple values are expected.

doi.label: DOI
doi.description: The material’s DOI, if one has been assigned.

educational_level.label: Educational level
educational_level.description: The expected learner level, such as beginner, intermediate or graduate. Who the material serves belongs in target audiences.

homepage.label: Homepage URL
homepage.description: A broader site about the material, if one exists. The direct link learners open belongs in the material URL field.

id.label: ID
id.description: Unique identifier assigned automatically when the training material record is created. The material’s DOI goes in its own field.

image.label: Image
image.description: A cover or representative image for the material. Leave empty if none is available.

in_languages.label: Content languages
in_languages.description: The languages in which the material is fully available — not languages used only in captions or examples.

learning_outcomes.label: Learning outcomes
learning_outcomes.description: The knowledge or skills a learner should gain by completing the material, one entry per outcome.

license.label: License
license.description: The license under which the material is released. Leave empty only if genuinely unknown.

material_url.label: Material URL
material_url.description: The direct link learners open to access the material. Use the homepage field for a broader site about it.

media_type.label: Media type
media_type.description: The technical format of the material, preferably a standard media type such as text/html, application/pdf or video/mp4.

name.label: Name
name.description: The title of the material, in one or more languages.

part_of_training_material.label: Part of training material (ID)
part_of_training_material.description: The larger training material this resource is a module or lesson of.

prerequisites.label: Prerequisites
prerequisites.description: Knowledge, skills, software or prior material learners should have before starting. Leave empty when none apply.

publisher.label: Publisher (ID)
publisher.description: The organization that formally publishes the material, if different from its creators.

related_datasets.label: Related datasets (IDs)
related_datasets.description: Datasets used as the subject or worked example of the material.

related_services.label: Related services (IDs)
related_services.description: Services the material explains how to access or use.

related_tools.label: Related tools (IDs)
related_tools.description: Tools the material teaches or demonstrates — not software merely used to produce it.

same_as.label: Same as (external URIs)
same_as.description: Links to records about this material in other systems, such as a training catalog. Its own pages belong in the homepage or material URL fields.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Keywords describing the material’s topics, used for search and filtering. Prefer terms from established vocabularies when possible.

target_audiences.label: Target audiences
target_audiences.description: The intended learner groups, such as researchers, librarians or students.

training_material_type.label: Training material type
training_material_type.description: How learners engage with the material, not its file format.

type.label: Type
type.description: Identifies this record as training material.

$self.label: Affiliation
$self.description: A person’s employment or membership at an organization, independent of any project.

affiliation_role.label: Role
affiliation_role.description: The person’s position at the organization — their job or status, not their project role.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.description: When the affiliation ended. Leave empty if it is still ongoing.

organization.label: Organization (ID)
organization.description: The organization the person is affiliated with.

$self.label: Authorship
$self.description: A person’s contribution to the publication, one entry per author.

author.label: Person (ID)
author.description: The person who contributed to the publication.

author_order.label: Author order
author_order.description: Position in the byline; 1 is the first author.

authorship_role.label: Authorship role
authorship_role.description: The kind of contribution. Author is the default for byline authors; use editor or translator for edited volumes and translations.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.description: When the contribution to the publication ended, if relevant.

start_date.label: Start date
start_date.description: When the contribution to the publication began, if relevant.

$self.label: Event agent
$self.description: A person or organization involved in the event in a specific capacity.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.description: When the involvement in the event ended. Only needed when it covers part of a multi-day event.

event_agent.label: Person or organization
event_agent.description: The person or organization involved in the event.

event_agent_role.label: Event role
event_agent_role.description: The capacity of the involvement, such as organizer, host, speaker or sponsor. Add a separate entry for each role.

start_date.label: Start date
start_date.description: When the involvement in the event began. Only needed when it covers part of a multi-day event.

$self.label: Facility affiliation
$self.description: The facility’s relationship with a hosting or owning organization.

end_date.label: End date
end_date.description: When the organization’s relationship with the facility ended. Leave empty if it is still ongoing.

facility_affiliation_role.label: Facility affiliation role
